index.heading: Shared building blocks
index.description: Every list, chart, form and note in the app is built from these. All data on these pages is synthetic.
index.gridSummary: Server-side sorting and paging, masked columns, permission-gated columns and actions, virtualised rows.
index.chartsSummary: Themed line and bar charts that load on demand, with a data table for screen readers.
index.formSummary: React Hook Form with a Zod schema, translated messages and accessible fields.
index.editorSummary: An editor whose output is a sanitized document, and a lightweight viewer.
index.dialogSummary: A modal that fills the screen on a phone and is a centred box from a tablet up, with a sticky header and footer.
index.calendarSummary: A day or week time grid that loads on demand, drawn at the hospital's time whatever the browser's timezone.
index.visualSummary: Cards, status badges, the switch, the ring gauge, the search field and the brand button.
